title: Baked Garlic and Basil Aubergines
blurb: Tender aubergine slices baked with garlic, basil and Parmesan until golden and soft.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Slice the aubergines into rounds about 1cm thick and arrange them in a single layer in a large baking dish.
Peel and thinly slice the garlic, then scatter it over the aubergine slices. Drizzle with the olive oil and pour the water around the edges of the dish.
Tear half the basil leaves and tuck them between the aubergine slices. Season with black pepper.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 40 minutes until the aubergine is very soft.
Remove the foil, grate the Parmesan over the top, and return to the oven uncovered for 20 minutes until golden.
Scatter the remaining basil leaves over the top before serving.
